title: Distinguishing Initial-Condition and Model Error Using Machine-Learning Weather Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.05592v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gated and ungated optimizations evaluated in GraphCast and Pangu-Weather. The first panel (upper-left) shows the mean over the 36 dates; remaining panels show first-of-month 12 UTC optimization descents from January-November 2017. The y-axis metric is the summed day 1-10 Z500 RMSE verified against ERA5, expressed as percent change from each model's date-matched control. The gated arm optimizes the initial conditions jointly with a LoRA weight correction; its GraphCast curve uses the initial conditions alone (LoRA removed), the same state Pangu receives. Stars and diamonds mark the lowest Pangu errors in the 5- and 10-day windows, respectively. Percentages above each panel show the best Pangu improvement relative to control for gated (green) and ungated (red) optimization. Ungated outperforms gated on half of dates when stopped early. translated_title: 利用机器学习天气模型区分初始条件误差与模型误差
translated_abstract: 在GraphCast和盘古气象大模型中评估了门控与非门控优化方法。第一张图（左上）显示了36个日期的平均结果；其余图显示了2017年1月至11月每月首日12 UTC的优化下降过程。纵轴指标为相对于ERA5验证的第1-10天Z500均方根误差（RMSE）之和，以各模型相对于日期匹配对照组的百分比变化表示。门控分支将初始条件与LoRA权重校正进行联合优化；其GraphCast曲线仅使用初始条件（去除LoRA），即盘古模型接收到的相同状态。星号和菱形分别标记了5天和10天窗口内盘古的最低误差。每张图上方的百分比显示了门控（绿色）和非门控（红色）优化相对于对照组的盘古最佳改进。当提前停止优化时，非门控方法在一半的日期上优于门控方法。门控并不能保证盘古模型性能更好，但它确实能产生更可比较的GraphCast和（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本研究通过在GraphCast和盘古气象大模型上对比门控与非门控优化方法，利用机器学习天气模型实现初始条件误差与模型误差的区分。
en_tdlr: This study distinguishes initial-condition errors from model errors using machine-learning weather models by comparing gated and ungated optimization approaches on GraphCast and Pangu-Weather.
